topic: How does the 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna impact link budget calculations for GEO-LEO satellite links?
consensus_response: The 41% efficient antenna reduces effective isotropic radiated power, increasing path losses and decreasing signal-to-noise ratio. This impacts beamforming, spatial multiplexing, and Doppler shift compensation, necessitating higher transmit powers or robust error correction to maintain reliability.
reference_context: SatCom systems consider link budget, power constraints, and antenna gains for reliable transmission.
